# UnitedHealthcare

> UnitedHealthcare offers health insurance plans and member services across Medicare, Medicaid, individual and family, employer, and supplemental coverage.

UnitedHealthcare serves people shopping for coverage, current members managing benefits, employers offering plans, and providers working with UnitedHealthcare networks. The site includes plan shopping, coverage education, member tools, wellness programs, and support resources.

## Main Plan Shopping
- [Health insurance plans](https://www.uhc.com): Homepage for exploring Medicare, Medicaid, employer, and individual coverage options.
- [Shop all insurance plans](https://www.uhc.com/shop-online-health-insurance-plans): Central hub for browsing and comparing UnitedHealthcare plan categories.
- [Individuals and families](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families): Coverage options for people buying their own health insurance.
- [Employer plans](https://www.uhc.com/employer): Group health plan information for employers and employees.
- [Community Plan](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan): Medicaid and Medicare-focused plans for eligible members and communities.
- [Dental, vision and supplemental plans](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans): Standalone and supplemental coverage for dental, vision, and financial protection.

## Medicare
- [Medicare](https://www.uhc.com/medicare): Overview of Medicare plan options, enrollment, and educational resources.
- [Medicare Advantage plans](https://www.uhc.com/medicare/medicare-advantage-plans): Medicare Part C plans with medical, drug, and extra benefits.
- [Medicare Supplement plans](https://www.uhc.com/medicare/medicare-supplement-plans): Medigap plans that help cover out-of-pocket Original Medicare costs.
- [Prescription drug plans](https://www.uhc.com/medicare/medicare-prescription-drug-plans): Medicare Part D plan options for prescription drug coverage.
- [Special Needs plans](https://www.uhc.com/medicare/special-needs-plans): Medicare plans tailored for people with specific health or eligibility needs.
- [Medicare education](https://www.uhc.com/medicare/medicare-education): Guides and explanations for Medicare parts, enrollment, and coverage choices.

## Medicaid and Community Plans
- [Community Plan home](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan): Entry point for Medicaid and community-based health plan information.
- [Medicaid plans](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan/medicaid): Medicaid coverage information and state-based plan access.
- [Dual Special Needs Plans](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan/medicare): Plans for people eligible for both Medicare and Medicaid.
- [Children and families](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan/medicaid/for-members/children-and-families): Resources for family-focused Medicaid benefits and support programs.
- [Community resources](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan/community-resources): Programs and support addressing health and social care needs.
- [Find a Community Plan by state](https://www.uhc.com/communityplan/state): State-specific Medicaid and community plan information.

## Individual and Family Coverage
- [Individuals and families home](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families): Overview of personal health insurance options and shopping paths.
- [ACA Marketplace plans](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/aca-marketplace): Marketplace coverage information for Affordable Care Act plans.
- [Short term health insurance](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/short-term-health-insurance): Temporary health coverage options for gaps between major medical plans.
- [Health plans through work](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/health-plans-through-work): Information for people covered by employer-sponsored UnitedHealthcare plans.
- [Student health plans](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/student-health-insurance): Health insurance options designed for students and academic institutions.
- [Individual and family plan education](https://www.uhc.com/individuals-families/health-insurance-basics): Educational content about plan types, costs, and coverage basics.

## Employer and Group Coverage
- [Employer home](https://www.uhc.com/employer): Overview of group health benefits and employer solutions.
- [Small business health insurance](https://www.uhc.com/employer/small-business-health-insurance): Group coverage options for small employers and growing businesses.
- [Large employer solutions](https://www.uhc.com/employer/large-organizations): Health benefit solutions for large organizations and enterprises.
- [Level funded plans](https://www.uhc.com/employer/level-funded-health-plans): Funding option combining predictable costs with potential savings.
- [Pharmacy benefits](https://www.uhc.com/employer/pharmacy-benefits): Employer pharmacy benefit solutions and prescription management programs.
- [Employee resources](https://www.uhc.com/employer/employee-resources): Tools and information for employees enrolled in employer-sponsored plans.

## Dental, Vision, and Supplemental
- [Dental, vision and supplemental plans](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans): Overview of supplemental insurance products and standalone benefits.
- [Dental insurance](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/dental-insurance): Dental plan options for preventive and restorative care coverage.
- [Vision insurance](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/vision-insurance): Vision plans covering exams, lenses, frames, and contacts.
- [Supplemental health insurance](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/supplemental-health-insurance): Additional financial protection for accidents, hospital stays, and critical illness.
- [Hearing coverage](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/hearing-insurance): Hearing-related benefits and plan information where available.
- [Bundled supplemental options](https://www.uhc.com/dental-vision-supplemental-plans/bundles): Combined plan options for multiple supplemental benefits.

## Member Resources and Tools
- [Member resources](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources): Hub for current members to manage coverage and benefits.
- [UnitedHealthcare app](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/unitedhealthcare-app): Mobile app for ID cards, claims, care, and account management.
- [Find a doctor](https://www.uhc.com/find-a-doctor): Provider search tool for doctors, specialists, and facilities.
- [Virtual visits](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/virtual-visits): Telehealth access and virtual care options for eligible members.
- [Claims and accounts](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/claims-and-accounts): Information for viewing claims, balances, and account activity.
- [Pharmacy and prescriptions](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/pharmacy-benefits): Prescription benefit tools, formularies, and medication resources.
- [Member forms](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/forms): Common forms and documents for plan administration and requests.

## Wellness and Health Programs
- [Health and wellness](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools): Tools and programs that support healthier habits and care decisions.
- [Rewards programs](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/rewards-programs): Incentive programs tied to healthy activities and plan participation.
- [Preventive care](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/preventive-care): Guidance on screenings, checkups, and preventive services.
- [Behavioral health](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/behavioral-health): Mental health and substance use support resources.
- [Chronic condition support](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/chronic-condition-support): Programs for managing ongoing health conditions and treatment plans.
- [Care management](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/health-care-tools/care-management): Support services for coordinating care and navigating complex needs.

## Education and Insurance Basics
- [Health insurance basics](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics): Introductory explanations of common insurance terms and concepts.
- [How health insurance works](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics/how-health-insurance-works): Overview of premiums, deductibles, copays, and networks.
- [Types of health insurance plans](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics/types-of-health-insurance-plans): Comparison of plan structures such as HMO, PPO, and more.
- [Open enrollment](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics/open-enrollment): Information about enrollment periods and qualifying life events.
- [Glossary](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics/glossary): Definitions for common health insurance and benefits terminology.
- [Choosing a plan](https://www.uhc.com/health-insurance-basics/choosing-a-plan): Guidance for comparing coverage, costs, and provider access.

## Support and Contact
- [Contact us](https://www.uhc.com/contact-us): Main contact page for members, shoppers, employers, and providers.
- [Help and support](https://www.uhc.com/member-resources/contact-us): Member-focused support options and service contacts.
- [Sign in](https://www.uhc.com/sign-in): Account access for members and other UnitedHealthcare users.
- [Register for an account](https://www.uhc.com/register): Account registration for online member access and tools.
- [Fraud and abuse reporting](https://www.uhc.com/fraud-and-abuse): Reporting resources for suspected fraud, waste, or abuse.
- [Accessibility and language assistance](https://www.uhc.com/legal/accessibility-language-assistance): Accessibility support and language help information.
